solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Fashion to drink whiskey where more people are around

indicators.note: something that drinks takes liquid in, so the fashion word swallows the whiskey letter

parts.note: the ton is fashionable society, or the current fashion
Whiskey is W in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A trendy bar crowd sipping whiskey somewhere busy.
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic description: a settlement is a place with more inhabitants nearby than open country.

clue.text: Article on English politician in tax drama

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above, so the article comes first

parts.note: the is the definite article

indicators.note: signals the two pieces go inside the word for tax

parts.note: to tax is to test or strain
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A tax-raising politician at the centre of a political drama.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's late play set on a magical island.

clue.text: Keep an eye on hunter?

definitions.meaning: a hunter is a pocket timepiece with a hinged cover

explanation.definitionFit: A hunter is a kind of pocket timepiece, and to keep an eye on is to observe.

clue.text: Island commander packing angry wound

indicators.note: the commander is packed in, stuffed between the words for angry and wound

parts.note: mad means angry
a scar is the mark of a wound
an aga is a Turkish military commander

explanation.surface: A furious officer carrying a wound on some island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'packing' is used loosely: the commander is what gets packed into the middle, not the one doing the packing.
explanation.definitionFit: A large island nation off the south-east coast of Africa.

clue.text: Armenian toyed with European girl

indicators.note: letters toyed with are played around with and rearranged

explanation.surface: An Armenian flirting with a European girl.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's forename, a double-barrelled given name.

clue.text: Two daughters introduced to beer become confused

indicators.note: one piece is introduced into another, put inside it

parts.note: ale is a beer
D is the abbreviation for daughter, so two give DD

explanation.surface: Two young women getting muddled after their first beer.
explanation.definitionFit: To addle is to muddle, or to grow muddled, like an addled egg going off.

clue.text: Answer in contemplation for comic

parts.note: someone in contemplation is musing, lost in thought

explanation.surface: A comedian thinking hard about a punchline.
explanation.definitionFit: Comic as an adjective, meaning funny or entertaining.

clue.text: Row in church turning one Gershwin against himself

indicators.note: turning a string round means reading it backwards

parts.note: Ira Gershwin, lyricist and brother of George
v is short for versus, against
himself refers back to the same Gershwin

explanation.surface: A church quarrel where one Gershwin brother argues with himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' reverses IRA V IRA to give ARIVARI.
explanation.definitionFit: A charivari is a noisy mock serenade, a din or uproar.

clue.text: Ancient arrow's point, bloodied all around?

indicators.note: one piece goes all around another, enclosing it

parts.note: something bloodied is red
E is east, a point of the compass

explanation.surface: An old arrowhead stained with blood.
explanation.definitionFit: Early arrow shafts were made of a cane or rush, the straight plant stem.

clue.text: Monster devouring rook and chicken part

indicators.note: what devours takes something inside it

parts.note: a beast is a monster
R is the chess abbreviation for rook

explanation.surface: A monster gobbling up a crow and a chicken.
explanation.definitionFit: A cut of poultry, the white meat from the front of the bird.

clue.text: Made bishop stop, surprised to be overheard within

indicators.note: signals that one piece sits inside the word for stop

parts.note: end means stop

indicators.note: what is overheard is heard spoken, so the word for surprised is replaced by one sounding the same

parts.note: thrown means disconcerted or surprised

explanation.surface: Someone startled into silence while being eavesdropped on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be overheard' swaps the word for surprised for a sound-alike seat of office, and 'within' puts it inside the stop word.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop is formally installed on the cathedra, his throne, when consecrated into office.

clue.text: Man having day to find employment

parts.note: man as the human race, which is us
day as an era, as in this day and age

explanation.surface: A man getting a day's work at a job centre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is mankind as a whole, giving US, not a single male.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage is the way something is used, the employment of a word or tool.

clue.text: Seraphim forced to abandon second tribe

indicators.note: letters forced out of shape are rearranged
abandoning a letter means leaving it out of the word

explanation.surface: Angels being made to desert a fellow member of their ranks.
explanation.walkthrough: Drop an S from SERAPHIM, then 'forced' rearranges ERAPHIM.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the twelve tribes of Israel, descended from a son of Joseph.

clue.text: Bring out drug in accordance with law

parts.note: E is short for ecstasy, a drug
licit means lawful

explanation.surface: Supplying a drug, but only legally.
explanation.definitionFit: To elicit is to draw out a response or information from someone.

clue.text: Notice lust with roué contrived such relationship?

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement

indicators.note: something contrived is put together artificially, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Spotting lust in a rake, who has engineered an affair.
explanation.definitionFit: An affair involving infidelity to a spouse, as the clue's whole picture suggests.

clue.text: Special troops when relaxed are radiant group

indicators.note: relaxed letters are loosened from their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: An elite unit that glows with good cheer once off duty.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman emperors' personal bodyguard, an elite military corps.

clue.text: What might be rice and grain store up in citadel

parts.note: rice might be a crop

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: a silo stores grain

explanation.surface: Rice harvested and stored in a granary.
explanation.definitionFit: The fortified hilltop of an ancient Greek city, as in Athens.

clue.text: Taking it all in having gone around planet?

indicators.note: one piece sits around another

parts.note: absent means gone away
an orb is a sphere, a planet

explanation.surface: An astronaut soaking in the view after orbiting a planet.
explanation.definitionFit: Absorbent materials soak up and retain liquid, drawing everything in.

clue.text: Barker having prepared speech about double-cross

indicators.note: one word goes round the others, surrounding them

parts.note: a spiel is a glib, well-rehearsed speech
a ringer is a lookalike or double
to span a river is to cross it

explanation.surface: A con man rehearsing his patter about a betrayal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barker' looks like a carnival tout, which fits the spiel, but it means a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A gundog breed, and a dog is something that barks.

clue.text: Principal in Number 10 wrong about one element

indicators.note: the principal letter of a word is its first

parts.note: the figures 1 and 0 look like the letters I and O

indicators.note: one word goes about another, enclosing it

parts.note: bum is slang for wrong or false, as in a bum steer
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A prime minister at Number 10 getting something elemental wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: Number 10 Downing Street is the British prime minister's residence, so 'Principal' looks like the PM.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemical element, a metal with atomic number 41.

clue.text: Poisonous sort given shocking treatment shows face

parts.note: an asp is a venomous snake
ECT is electroconvulsive therapy, treatment by electric shock

explanation.surface: A venomous person receiving shock therapy shows their true face.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspect is a side or facet of something, one face it presents.

clue.text: Beard model put to work

indicators.note: one piece is put beside another, here attached after it

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
to pose is what a model does

explanation.surface: A bearded man hired as a model.
explanation.walkthrough: To beard someone is to confront them boldly, as in bearding the lion in his den.
explanation.definitionFit: Bearding someone is confronting or defying them face to face, much like standing against them.

clue.text: Central characters in Huxley said to stand out?

indicators.note: the letters are spoken aloud, giving a word that sounds like them
the central letters of a word are its middle ones

explanation.surface: Speaking of Huxley's main characters as outstanding.
explanation.definitionFit: To excel is to be outstanding, to rise above the rest.

clue.text: Check on heartbeat

parts.note: re means on or concerning
the pulse is the throb of the heartbeat

explanation.surface: A doctor taking a patient's pulse.
explanation.definitionFit: To check an attack is to drive it back or repel it.

clue.text: Shortening piece of verse, try peculiar vocabulary

indicators.note: shortening a word cuts off its end

parts.note: a line is a single piece of a poem
a go is a try or attempt

explanation.surface: A poet cutting a line short and trying odd words.
explanation.definitionFit: Lingo is a jargon or language particular to a group.

clue.text: Certain characters within decide against proposal

indicators.note: some of the letters inside the words give the answer

explanation.surface: A committee deciding to reject a proposal.
explanation.definitionFit: An idea is a suggestion or plan put forward.

clue.text: Asian city and Greek one without parking

indicators.note: without means lacking, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: Delphi is a Greek city, home of the oracle
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: Two cities compared, one Indian and one Greek with nowhere to park.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital region of India, a major city in South Asia.

clue.text: Getting louder? Time to exit street party!

indicators.note: a letter exits, so it leaves the word

parts.note: a crescent is a curved street
a do is a party

explanation.surface: Neighbours telling noisy revellers it's time to leave the street party.
explanation.walkthrough: CRESCENT loses its T to give CRESCEN.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a crescendo is a passage of gradually increasing volume.

clue.text: Understand when it's e-mail that's encrypted

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I arrived'

indicators.note: encrypted text has its letters scrambled

explanation.surface: Struggling to read an encrypted message.
explanation.definitionFit: To assimilate information is to absorb and comprehend it fully.

clue.text: Person managing excellent American stud

definitions.meaning: a manager or chief in charge of workers
US slang for first-rate or great
a raised knob or ornamental stud on a shield

explanation.surface: An American manager who is also a ladies' man.
explanation.definitionFit: Three senses: a supervisor, American slang for superb, and a raised ornamental knob.
